# Colecto v0.11.3

Fixes for the Linux Wayland app icon, Gmail IMAP folders, font switching and design transitions, snappier context menus, global zoom shortcuts, and leaner builds. (Supersedes the unpublished `v0.11.2` tag.)

## Changes

- **Linux Wayland app icon**: Renamed the desktop entry to `com.kogical.colecto.desktop` with `StartupWMClass=com.kogical.colecto` to match GTK's `APPLICATION_ID`, installed both `colecto.svg` and `colecto.png` across `.deb`/`.rpm`, `.AppImage`, tarball, and all AUR packages (`colecto`, `colecto-bin`, `colecto-git`), and set the GTK window icon with a bundled fallback so Wayland and X11 show Colecto's logo instead of the generic Wayland icon.
- **Gmail Inbox & folder names**: Fixed Gmail `INBOX` appearing empty due to case mismatch with the lowercase cache key, normalized `INBOX` to `Inbox`, matched Inbox/Drafts by folder role, and automatically fetch uncached folders on first open.
- **Fonts & design switching**: Reworked font propagation across all five design systems (`shadcn`, Fluent, macOS, Material 3, Cupertino), added a grouped font picker (`THIS DESIGN`, `BUNDLED FONTS`, `SYSTEM FONTS`), and added a prompt when switching designs with a custom font set.
- **Instant design transitions**: Switching designs now updates the Settings modal immediately (no lingering bottom sheet when leaving iOS design) and eliminates the translucent box when switching to macOS.
- **Context menus & chrome**: Replaced per-frame menu blur with crisp, trigger-origin scale/opacity animations; removed static `Mail`, `Reader`, and `Accounts` pane header tabs; centered the top bar logo; added a rotating footer refresh icon; and kept notifications always above Settings.
- **Command palette & zoom**: Updated the top bar trigger across all designs to indicate commands (`Ctrl`/`⌘` `K`), restored **Reload app** in the command palette, and made `Ctrl/Cmd +`, `-`, and `0` work globally (including inside Settings).
- **Size, memory & drawing performance**: Enabled size-optimized thin-LTO Cargo release builds, bounded in-memory message content and summary caches, removed scrolling `BackdropFilter` passes, cached sorted threads and logo paths, and added repaint boundaries.
- **Release CI**: Added retry logic around Android APK builds to absorb transient Gradle Plugin Portal resolution flakes.
